items.name: Brian Heder
items.desc: Old-school Keys drug runner. Jason works for him and lives under his roof.

items.name: Cal Hampton
items.desc: Jason's best friend in the Keys. Coast Guard radio, beers and conspiracy theories.

items.name: Jason Duval
items.desc: Army past, Keys present. Runs jobs for Brian Heder until Lucia walks out of prison.

items.name: Lucia Caminos
items.desc: Liberty City born, raised to fight. Fresh out of Leonida Penitentiary on an ankle monitor.

items.name: Lori Heder
items.desc: Brian Heder's third wife. Sangria, a rifle within reach, and the Keys boat yard.

items.name: Raul Bautista
items.desc: Vice City bank robber shopping for talent. Pass his tests or stay out.

items.name: Boobie Ike
items.desc: Jack of Hearts owner, money behind Only Raw. Jason and Lucia's landlord.

items.name: Dre'Quan Priest
items.desc: Jason's old friend. Runs Only Raw Records with Boobie Ike, and Real Dimez are his act.

items.name: Ernesto
items.desc: Raymond's partner. Only ever a voice on the phone.

items.name: Phil
items.desc: Owner of Phil's Ammu-Nation. More guns than the law allows.

items.name: Raymond
items.desc: San 4 San at the top of Venture Apartments. Holding bricks Boobie wants back.

items.name: Wyman
items.desc: Mechanic, collector and Mud Club regular. Brings wrecked classics back to life.

items.name: Andres de Leon
items.desc: MegaMundo's telenovela star, married to its COO. Needs bodyguards to stay on schedule.

items.name: Bae-Luxe
items.desc: The other half of Real Dimez. Never off camera, still chasing the DWNPLY hit.

items.name: DWNPLY
items.desc: Leonida rap star. Cut the early hit that made Real Dimez.

items.name: Erin Henshaw
items.desc: Running for mayor of Ambrosia, with the sugar refinery behind the campaign.

items.name: Gustavo Herrera
items.desc: Head of security for the Navarro family at the MegaMundo opening.

items.name: Petra Navarro
items.desc: MegaMundo's COO, married to its biggest star. Keeps opening night on schedule.

items.name: Roxy
items.desc: One half of Real Dimez with Bae-Luxe. Signed to Only Raw Records, chasing a second hit.

items.name: Rudi
items.desc: The Leonida Man. Climbed out of a moving pickup for the camera. RIP Rudi.

items.name: Stefanie
items.desc: Lucia's counselor inside. Runs the supervised release that gets her out on a monitor.
